title: VTA did:webs DIDs List — payload
description: Enumerate the did:webs DIDs a VTA holds that the caller may see, optionally narrowed to a context or hosting server. Alpha.

serverId.description: Only DIDs published through this hosting server.

includeDeactivated.description: Include deactivated DIDs. Absent means no.

cursor.description: Opaque position from a previous response's `nextCursor`. The VTA accepts only a cursor it issued, for the same filters.

limit.description: The most DIDs to return. Absent lets the VTA choose.

Response.title: VTA did:webs DIDs List — response payload

dids.description: Matching DIDs the caller may see. An empty array is a successful answer, and does not imply the VTA holds none.

nextCursor.description: Position of the next page. Absent on the last page.
